definitions.explanation: The act of transferring money from one bank account to another.

examples.japanese: {振込|ふりこみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
{振込|ふりこみ}⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦ATM→ATM：08755_eetiiemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{振込|ふりこみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a transfer at the ATM.

notes:
{振込|ふりこみ} refers to a bank transfer, one of the most common payment methods in Japan for bills, rent, and business transactions.

FORMS:
Noun form of ⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧ (to transfer money into an account).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振込|ふりこみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a transfer
- {振込|ふりこみ}⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: transfer fee
- ⟦{振込先|ふりこみさき}→振込先：23203_furikomisaki⟧: transfer destination (account)
- {振込|ふりこみ}⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: transfer deadline

TRANSFER METHODS:
- ⟦ATM→ATM：08755_eetiiemu⟧{振込|ふりこみ}: ATM transfer
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧{振込|ふりこみ}: online transfer
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧{振込|ふりこみ}: over-the-counter transfer

WATCH OUT:
{振込|ふりこみ}⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧ (wire fraud / transfer scam) is a well-known type of scam in Japan targeting elderly people.
